clauses.current_legal_basis: The order's own held text, as amended by EO 10942, with no own-terms end and no revocation found by the bounded searches current-law:usc, current-law:ecfr and later-events:ofr_catalog; 14 CFR 1221.102 (eCFR through 2026-10-15) still states the seal was established by the order as amended; checked through 2026-10-14.
clauses.reason: The clause approves the described design as the official seal of NASA. EO 10942 (signed 1961-05-19) revised the description of the design (brown rather than gray-blue shadow) and left the approval in place; 14 CFR 1221.102 as held states that the seal was established by EO 10849 as amended by EO 10942, and 51 U.S.C. 20111 prints the order in a note. No later instrument ends it.

research_rationale:
EO 10849 (24 FR 9559, signed 1959-11-27) recites that the Administrator of NASA caused a seal to be made, describes its design, and approves it as the official seal of the National Aeronautics and Space Administration. The held Federal Register original has no sunset, condition or revocation clause. One later instrument acts on it: EO 10942 (signed 1961-05-19; held 26 FR 4419) amends EO 10849 by revising the description of the design of the seal, replacing the description of the shadow cast by the wings as gray-blue with brown; the approval of the seal and its status as the official seal are not changed. The held eCFR text of 14 CFR 1221.102 (amended through 2026-10-15) states that the NASA Seal was established by EO 10849 as amended by EO 10942 (that text gives the amending order's Federal Register cite and date differently from the held Federal Register page, which is 26 FR 4419 for an order signed 1961-05-19), and the held U.S. Code text of 51 U.S.C. 20111 prints the order in its notes. The held texts attributed to EO 10850 and EO 10854 are Federal Register page extracts with no provision affecting EO 10849 (EO 10850's held page begins with EO 10849 itself). the bounded machine searches current-law:usc, current-law:ecfr and later-events:ofr_catalog were read for coverage and show no revocation or supersession.
